title: the waiting-page writer refuses a reserved or duplicate option key
why: Incident, Oct 28 12:47 CDT (orchestrator): triage 11 wrote waiting page item 44 with an option keyed "none", which the page reserves for its built-in "None of these" button. The page's problem() blocked the item on shiv's screen with a yellow warning and unselectable options. Fixed in the data by deleting that option (the built-in button covers it).
note: The page already refuses a missing, duplicate or reserved key at render time (skills/waiting-page/page.html, problem(), NONE = "none"), so the defect reached shiv before anyone saw it. Next cloud lane: the skill's write path refuses the same three cases before the item is written, reading the page's own NONE constant (building-allow-list-is-the-constant), and SKILL.md names "none" as reserved next to the options field. Red first: writing item 44's old shape is refused. Checked Oct 28: every other open decision item has unique, non-reserved keys. Needs no answer. Port: yes, the skill installs everywhere. Due after c187, which merged Oct 28 16:22 CDT (batch 13): ready now. Placed ahead of c95 (triage 12, Oct 28; was after c187, triage 11): a real incident on shiv's page.
